attributionNote: stale_local_state: the chain's live arithmetic reproduces the chain's own reported profit while the off-chain figure differs from the chain's live figure, so the off-chain side ran on a pool state the chain had already moved past. offchain_arithmetic: the off-chain figure also differs from the chain's live figure, so the computation itself is under suspicion and must be repaired.
stateAgeNote: The pool state the off-chain side used is the latest snapshot in the local store. When it trails the chain-side review, a deviation reflects a state the chain had already moved past, not a simulator defect.

gate.rule: deviationCount must be 0 before the chain-side preview may be closed
